messages:
emma: Heads-up: small but important billing update rolling out next week — soft-cap per-route + automatic free-credit redemption change. Short summary below.

emma: TL;DR: (1) soft-cap lets teams set a soft daily spend cap per-route that triggers gentle throttling (not hard block) and a grace token buffer; (2) free credits will auto-apply to metered usage first, but not to routes attached to a prepaid/enterprise pool unless explicitly configured.

raj: Why: customers wanted fewer surprise hard cutoffs and clearer behavior for free credits when mixing prepaid and metered configs. This aims to reduce friendly-support escalations.

finance-bot: Soft-cap mechanics: admin sets soft_cap_usd on a route. When route spend nears that cap (>= 95%), we start returning informative 429-like responses with X-RateLimit-Warning header and consume a grace token per request. Grace tokens live for 24h and are billed at the end of day prorated.

cs-bot: Support impact: CS will see a new field in usage alerts "soft_cap_status" and canned responses for customers who see temporary throttles. One-pager: <https://redwood.internal/cs/soft-cap-playbook|soft-cap playbook>.

emma: Free-credit change: trial/promo credits will auto-apply to standard metered routes as before. However, if a route is explicitly bound to a prepaid pool or enterprise contract, free credits will not be consumed there unless the org enables "allow_free_credit_on_pools" in billing settings. We want predictable accounting for prepaid contracts.

oliver: CLI example to set soft cap: 
```
redwood routes update --route /api/generate --billing.soft_cap_usd 250 --billing.grace_tokens 100
```

ops-bot: Rollout plan: billing-service v4.1.0, canary Thursday 01:00 UTC -> global over 4 hours. Feature flags: billing.soft_caps.v1, billing.pool_free_credit_toggle.v1. Post-deploy job migrates any org-level default flags.

finance-bot: Invoicing: grace-token usage billed as a separate prorated line item with route label. Refunds for unused grace tokens allowed within 14 days; see billing policy.

raj: Rate limits unchanged: soft-cap is a billing/usage control, not a replacement for rate limiting. Quotas and QPS limits still apply.

emma: CS/Legal/Finance must review invoice line-item labels for clarity. I added the draft to the launch doc. If no blockers, public docs + Console banner on Tuesday 14:00 PT.

cs-bot: CS standby recommended for 48h post-GA. Canned replies updated.

emma: Any objections?

raj: none from product.

finance-bot: accounting ok pending revenue recognition note in runbook.

emma: Thanks — will publish final launch notes tomorrow. :thumbsup:
